name: Salary
overview: Scripture clearly commands fair and timely payment of wages, emphasizing that an employer must not withhold the earnings of a hired worker even overnight, as seen in Leviticus 19:13. The Bible warns against oppressing or defrauding servants, highlighting God's judgment against those who withhold rightful pay (Deuteronomy 24:14; Jeremiah 22:13; Malachi 3:5). Jesus affirms the principle that workers deserve their sustenance, underscoring the dignity of labor and just compensation (Matthew 10:10). The example of hiring laborers in the vineyard (Matthew 20:1) further illustrates the value God places on honoring agreements with those who serve.
